author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Authority / mandate
Principal authorization granted 2026-11-15. Execute autonomously via existing QIK-VRT DevOps/TEMDD/EMP/EAP pipeline, authority repository ONLY `ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt`. No new Site, mirror, Vercel path, parallel writer, unattended merge/deploy without gates. Do not ask principal to manually execute routine engineering steps.

## Reproduced blocker (evidence)
- PR #751 exact HEAD `fdb5d0483600b98dbf1ff15e2becf7e7baf657fc` (draft).
- `QIKVRT CI` run 43661695886: `completed/action_required`, **zero jobs**. All 13 PR-triggered runs on that SHA have the same conclusion.
- Commit `fdb5d048...` author/committer `github-actions[bot]`; all 13 runs actor and triggering_actor `github-actions[bot]`.
- Existing `.github/workflows/qikvrt_reflexive_repository_watchdog.yml` lines 269–299: exact-HEAD manifest-trio regeneration, `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`, bot commit, `gh auth setup-git`, push to PR branch.
- TEMDD hypothesis: GitHub Actions workflow approval for bot-written PR HEAD. Verify exact policy via privileged API/UI or audit evidence; do NOT equate `action_required` alone with proof of the specific GitHub policy.
- Existing connected GitHub App installation for `ingolf-lohmann`: installation ID `147838968`; installation identity/permissions are **not** yet verified as suitable for autonomous workflow-triggering writes. `Goldkelch` has a separate installation. Do not assume either installation's credentials are accessible from the runner.

## Required implementation sequence (synchronous, no polling timers)
1. Read latest PR #751 HEAD, active writer/lease, workflow YAML, token sources, repository security policy and installation permissions. Fail closed if another authorized writer is active.
2. Independently confirm precise `action_required` admission cause. Preserve diagnostic receipt and classify permission vs workflow approval vs policy.
3. Prefer a repository-scoped, least-privilege GitHub App installation-token writer for bot-originated PR updates; reuse a verified suitable existing installation if actually available. Never commit secrets or use a personal long-lived PAT. Token minting must be explicitly authorized and runtime-capable, with expiry/permission checks.
4. Preserve exact-HEAD CAS, writer fencing, single writer, deterministic integrity trio, SHA receipts and idempotent successor handling. No automatic fallback to `GITHUB_TOKEN` for a write requiring downstream CI.
5. Add positive and negative TEMDD tests: token unavailable/expired/insufficient permissions; concurrent writer; HEAD drift; no-op; wrong repository; workflow `action_required`; absent jobs; CI failure; duplicate successor; replay; app unavailable. Avoid infinite bot-triggered CI loops.
6. Commit once on an authorized repair branch, regenerate canonical manifest trio, independently verify drift and consumer compatibility, run local regression, then trigger/observe complete native Exact-HEAD CI (including integrity and reviews). An accepted API call is NOT a completed CI run.
7. Only after all gates: integrate to main per policy, write ONLY existing QIK-VRT Sites instance, independently read back Originalhost/mTLS/Mesh/EAP effect and ACK journal; `EFFECT_ACK_DONE=true` only with evidence.
8. If GitHub UI requires human authentication, emit one precise actionable authorization requirement in the existing coordination workbench, not repeated routine status messages. Preserve `CONTINUATION_REQUIRED / EFFECT_ACK_DONE=false`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Fresh App-authorized commit to PR branch triggers full PR CI with actual jobs (not `action_required`), verified at the same exact HEAD.
- Failure-path tests and integrity SHA evidence pass; independent review/governance gates satisfied.
- No personal credential leakage, no parallel writers, no new Sites instance, no unverified deployment.
- End-to-end independent EAP readback and persisted ACK, otherwise remain BLOCKED with explicit next executable action.

## Relationship
Unblock and complete PR #751; do not create a competing controller. This issue is a durable execution contract, **not** evidence of implementation or production effect.
title: P0 TEMDD: eliminate bot-originated PR CI action_required deadlock via authorized App writer
